realview.title: RealView settings
realview.fp.connected: FP Studio found: smooth compatibility is active
realview.opt.enabled.tip: Master switch for the whole mod.
realview.opt.cameraEffects.tip: Bob, tilt and impacts of the camera.
realview.opt.handEffects.tip: Motion of hands and held items.
realview.opt.replaceVanillaBobbing.tip: Vanilla view bobbing is switched off while the mod works (your video setting is not changed).
realview.opt.maxAngle.tip: Limit in degrees for extra pitch/yaw so aiming stays accurate.
realview.opt.sprintBob.tip: Extra bob and lean while sprinting.
realview.opt.sneakCalm.tip: How much bob calms down when sneaking.
realview.opt.breathing.tip: Idle breathing sway; stronger when hungry or hurt.
realview.opt.handInertia.tip: Hands lag behind when you turn.
realview.opt.handSprintPose.tip: Hands drop and tilt while sprinting.
realview.opt.handJumpLand.tip: Hands react to jumps and landings.
realview.opt.fpstudioMode.tip: PAUSE_ALL: everything fades out smoothly. KEEP_CAMERA: only hands fade. KEEP_ALL: nothing changes.
realview.opt.fpstudioFadeTime.tip: Seconds to fade effects out and in around a clip.
realview.opt.showBody.tip: Show your own body (torso, legs, armor) when you look down.
realview.opt.bodyOffset.tip: How far the body is moved back so it does not clip into the view.
realview.opt.bodyHideHeldItems.tip: Held items are already in your hands, do not draw them twice.
realview.opt.parcoolCompat.tip: Calm camera and hands during ParCool actions (roll, vault, wall run, dodge...).
realview.opt.parcoolCameraScale.tip: Camera effects strength while a ParCool action runs (0 = off).
realview.opt.parcoolHandScale.tip: Hand effects strength while a ParCool action runs (0 = off).
realview.opt.parcoolLandingScale.tip: Landing impact strength when ParCool answers the landing.
realview.opt.parcoolHideBody.tip: Hide the first-person body during ParCool actions (its poses look odd from inside).
